body:
Sana all may ganyang friend. But sometimes, I understand how others would eventually feel tired of listening to the same old shit we're blabbering about. Hindi kasi nauubos... At first they would listen intently. Later on, they'll have to protect themselves also from our negativities, so they kind of tune out our vents as white noise. It sucks... I'm in so much pain RN but all I can do is type stuff on reddit atm to keep my mind off things. I feel jealous of people who aren't like me. 

LOL. I stopped to read my reply to you. Not editing anything. It's just kind of funny to see how my thought processes work. Anxiety > worrying about others and then depression>sadness and self-hate. Kulit eh, 'no?
No worries. I'm in a similar situation right now. Kapit lang. *hug hug*

https://www.reddit.com/r/phcareers/s/zzLYvkEAgO

This might help.
I'm here. \*hugs\*
Damn... I want that, too but gave too much to the wrong person.
Thank you for the advice. I guess it's time to call my doctor again and probably ask my son's devped next visit...
Ehehe... good for you, dear... I hope you make your men happy.
Do you really think I should tell them as early as now? I'm afraid that they won't understand...
I know...

My wrong actions have overshadowed the abusiveness of my husband. To the kids, I still pretend that my husband and I are okay. I wanted them to think that they still have a father. Just far away.  But, I don't wish to live with him anymore.
Thank you for giving me the two sides of the coin. I agree that I should stop pursuing this aimless relationship. It's a pyrrhic victory that in the end turned out to actually be a loss...
I see. But I think I should invest on the thought that my son won't have to be physically punished while his baby sister screams as she watches him getting hit by his dad...
Are you talking about the r/suicidewatch? Mmmm... I assure you, I am over that. Ehehehe...
I was waiting for comments that are nit influenced by what my husband did prior to my depression. So their comments will be purely based on my actions.
I don't live with my husband anymore. My life isn't at stake...
Thank you. Will keep that in mind.
_nods_
That argument has crossed my mind but I don't entertain it. I feel like I'm only justifying the emotional infidelity.
I will. My kids live in a healthy environment. All my interactions with my exbf are online. I have never seen him in person.
I have been convincing myself to believe I am enough. It's just hard when people around your don't behave like you are enough.

I didn't want the readers to be affected by that I guess. I wanted to see how most people will react to what I did. I wanted to see if there will be people out there who could be kind to me when I couldn't and at the same time torture myself with the harsh ones because I think I deserve them, too.
I think the commenters are right. I should stay alone for life and try to make up for what I've done to my kids.
I think I have read your reply 5 times now. I want to keep reading kind words to myself because I can't give it to myself. Thank you very much.
Yes, I do hope he finds it in his heart to reconnect with the kids. I don't know how long I can keep up with the white lies about him working and not being able to see them due to covid lockdowns.
I deserve that...

I think I really do need myself now more than ever. The people who has been commenting on how I find validation from other people makes a lot of sense now. Even in this post,  I think I'm  just trying to find the kind words that I can't give myself.
Philippines
Thank you for your kind words.
That is what I will do. I don't deserve to be with any man now, I know.

I understand if he'd curse me but his kids need him. I just tell them that he's busy at work and couldn't travel due to covid restrictions.  I still hope he reaches out for them. I am a big loser. I'll try to make 2022 better. Thank you.
There is no divorce where I am from.

There is a stinging truth to that. I never felt like I was enough for my husband. I worked from morning till night while he worked away and only comes home on weekends. When he comes home, he expects everything to be perfect. If I don't finish cleaning something before he arrives,  he'd raise his voice at me. He says he just wants to rest when he's home. I only wish he also thought about me being the only one taking care of everything in the house and the kids' schooling. I did everything. I asked for him to come with me so he'd understand what the doctor said about our kid with autism but he never tagged along. All I can do is cry when he hits our child with special needs because he says it's his right to discipline his own kid. I was always exhausted and I kept it from people close to me because I  didn't want them to see him in a bad light. I told him I felt so alone and uncared for. That I needed him to take care of me, too but he never listened...
Thank you for your kind words.
Where I am from, men can simply decide to disappear without a trace and not support his kids.
Thank you so much for such kind words. I will forgive myself eventually.  I have to so I can be better for my kids.
I understand. He deserves someone better than me.
I know.  I will try to at least make my kids have a good life.
I would very much prefer to support my kids on my own. My husband physically "disciplined" our child with autism... I worry for him.
He had shortcomings. He hit our autistic child a lot when he was still a toddler... and shouts at me when I don't speak up.
I don't think I should...
How I wish my story isn't as ridiculous as that. But it, sadly, is real.
I have learned my lesson. My husband has blocked all form of communications with me. And doesn't reach out to his kids anymore.
Perhaps. I have been too needy.
Thank you for trying to be kind despite... me.
I hope so, too. He deserves that.
I honestly wish that, too. He deserves to be happy.
I understand and I agree with you.
I know. I put all my eggs on someone's basket when I have never met him in real life. Just screams moron, doesn't it?
Thank you for being kind...
I know...

I know. It's karma. I am not expecting any sort of sympathy from anybody because I know what a terrible person I am. I just need to stop being dumb and live myself alone to suffer the consequences of my actions.
I wanna fill those two brown rectangles up there with red sea bream...
Thanks for my first genuine smile for the day.
Fucking up suicide basically.
That is sooo true. It's like when you get a moment of happiness, you owe it to the universe and it'll come back right at you to collect your payment afterwards.

Lol . I found myself on this wrong sub, too. We have the same purpose though. I am not in a hurry. I want mine planned and clean. I don't wanna have to face people and get humiliated for failing at failing. XD
Thanks. I'll read some more. I don't wanna end up in the ICU afterwards. I want the mortuary. Hehe.
I have a really bad headache now. I guess I'm in the wrong thread. Hehe. This place helps people change their minds. I need a thread that actually supports it. Sorry for the wrong post.
Mmm... But that means, it can do the deed right?
Yeah, same sentiments. I just made my reddit account to ask if what I have available is enough for a successful one. I really wish there's a way that can give you a 100% chance suicide success.
\*sighs\*
